t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different gnomes give out points between 0 - 9 and there are two group types of gnomes.

vb_textbox.text: Different coloured gnomes provide points between 0-9. They are divided into 2 groups - group 1 has red, blue, pink and purple, and group 2 has brown, yellow, green and orange. One gorup provides more point than the other one. Try to aim for group 1 gnomes than group 2 and make sure to utilise the x5 points for group 1 as much as possible. This increase your score significantly. Although, sometimes you might even receive 0 points for any group. Hope this helps you earn the highest points. All the best :)
